The reactant_smiles for each includes some weird reagents like Cl, etc. They seem not the simple aldehyde + malonic acid. But maybe the template is generic and includes leaving groups.

We need to return the mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule below, reproduces the reaction. The molecule below likely is the product (cinnamic acid). So we need the template that maps to that product. Any of these could work, but we need the correct one. That seems like a complex multi-step? Might be not.

The other entries have similar mapped_rxn but include Cl etc. Probably the template is the same but with different leaving groups.

The first entry includes [OH-].[Na+].Cl which could be base and chloride. The reactant includes [O:1]=[C:2]1[O:3]C(...). Hard to parse.
